about: Measured hosted test times for ci/hosted-test-shard (TAL-2390): each class's suite time and each method's time, the larger of main CI runs 44177457581 and 44127296524 (both at four shards on xcode-27). A class or method without a measurement uses the fallback, the median of the measured ones; the planner prints which it used. Replace the tables from a newer full run's shard logs when they drift.

timeline.about: Seconds, from the same runs' job steps. artifact: the build runner's start to its uploaded test build (build for testing, package, upload). download: that artifact onto a shard. startup: a shard's start to a booted, prepared simulator, which overlaps the build. launch: the test step beyond its suites' own time. post: reports and uploads after the tests.
